state.name: world_memory
state.description: Mean of the six realm meters, recomputed whenever one changes. Under 25 at the end: The Architect Rises. 65+ is needed for Remembered Whole.

state.name: echoes
state.description: Currency gained by witnessing (lore objects, Remind, Six Realms wins, Concentration pairs); spent to record, to Recall in battle, and to retell a forgotten request.

state.name: izladar_fragments
state.description: What the party has learned of who Izladar was. Nine sources (section 13); 6+ needed for Remembered Whole; 4+ before Star Chart III makes every line known.

state.name: ward_names_kept
state.description: Pairs kept in Concentration I (0-6). 5+ gives the Galechanters trust. Accepted 2026-11-15 (names become ground): each name kept is a lit lantern, with that patient's name on it, in s_run_bone_bridge and s_run_expanse; three or more lost leave those stretches dark.

state.name: monolith_rows
state.description: Rows of the monolith read in Slipping Glyph I (0-3). 3 gives a fragment; read rows are pre-filled in Glyph III.

state.name: stars_redrawn
state.description: Constellations named across all Star Chart pages. Accepted 2026-11-15 (stars become the route): each constellation's Record entry lights its realm's band in s_flight_descent for good.

state.name: tribes_trusted
state.description: How many of the six trust flags are true.

state.name: realms_matches_won
state.description: Six Realms matches won.

state.name: witnesses_lost
state.description: Witnesses killed by the Remnants.

state.name: requests_done
state.description: Requests delivered (0-6).

state.name: seals_cracked
state.description: Seals cracked (0-3): after chapter 3, after chapter 6, entering the Expanse.

state.name: moot_watches_left
state.description: Watches left in the Rim Moot night; each activity costs one.

state.name: trust.wood
state.description: The wood tribe trusts the pairs: from a Six Realms win, its request, or (sky) Concentration I at 5+, or (celestial) Star Chart I complete plus the request. Gives one aid in the final battle and a shard set for the Anchor.

state.name: trust.sky
state.description: The sky tribe trusts the pairs: from a Six Realms win, its request, or (sky) Concentration I at 5+, or (celestial) Star Chart I complete plus the request. Gives one aid in the final battle and a shard set for the Anchor.

state.name: name_in_record
state.description: THE NAME (Shallock Izladar) has entered the Record, in the forbidden chamber.

state.name: name_recorded
state.description: THE NAME was recorded at a crystal and is kept; needed to retell it at the Moot fire and for the Priory request.

state.name: priory_charts_complete
state.description: All three constellations of Star Chart I were named.

state.name: sigil_seen
state.description: The Sigil of Izladar has formed in Star Chart I.

state.name: ilvarra_met
state.description: The party has met Ilvarra at the Rim Moot.

state.name: ilvarra_memory_kept
state.description: Concentration III reached 9+ pairs: Ilvarra keeps her knowledge of the Imprisonment.

state.name: killlist_read
state.description: Four or more rows of the Remnants kill-list were read.

state.name: unwriter_name_known
state.description: The Unwriter's given-up name is known (Kael followed the Eraser, or the kill-list's fifth row was read); enables Remind in his battle. Accepted 2026-11-15: the name is Dorrin Vael, and the kill-list's fifth row is signed with it.

state.name: unwriter_reminded
state.description: The Unwriter was reminded of his name instead of defeated.

state.name: because_of_us_recorded
state.description: Accepted 2026-11-15. Aetherius's answer to Aeris, "Because of us" (WW 149), was written into the Record during s_flight_aetherius (Record, within ten seconds of the line; her song rests 8 s). At Ilvarra's fire a party that holds it can say it back when she tells The Price.

state.name: price_told
state.description: Accepted 2026-11-15. Ilvarra has told The Price at the Moot fire: the dragons' dormancy was what the six tribes paid for the seal. Set in s_moot_camp. Read at the choice and by the endings: with it, their closing text names the bargain (section 13).

state.name: choir_opened
state.description: Heartstone II tuned the Bone Choir.

state.name: seal_text_read
state.description: All six rows of the seal were read in Slipping Glyph III.

state.name: izladar_constellation_drawn
state.description: Star Chart III drew the Scholar's constellation in full.

state.name: anchor_forged
state.description: Heartstone III forged the Anchor. Needed for Remembered Whole.

state.name: ilvarra_alive
state.description: Ilvarra lives. False only if the player chooses to go on without her at the bone bridge, or burns her Record entry.

state.name: heartstone_kept
state.description: Which memory Rhyla keeps in Heartstone I. vision gives a fragment. Accepted 2026-11-15 (the Heartstone's memory changes rooms): founding, Stonekeeper home hexes cannot be tide-taken in any Six Realms match; vision, the Architect's Echo's intents are shown in s_battle_echo; song, s_heart_choir starts with one rib tuned and the tuned rib is audible in s_bone_choir.

state.name: kael_choice
state.description: Kael in the tunnels: saved_witness gives a fragment; followed kills the witness and reveals the Unwriter's name.

state.name: ysolde
state.description: Accepted 2026-11-15. Ysolde, the archivist Kael saved in the tunnels, asks at the Moot fire to have her Record entry Burned. none: she is not at the fire (kael_choice is not saved_witness). kept: the party keeps her entry; she stays on the kill-list as a witness. let_off: her entry was Burned as a mercy (burned ledger, memory.below -4); her row on the kill-list is struck and she is no longer a witness.

state.name: fourth_row_parts
state.description: Still parts of the monolith's fourth row noticed and recorded in the world (0-6), one a realm: the crack in the split tree (s_cedar_grove), a rune on Aetherius's scales (s_cloud_platform), a vein in the Heartstone (s_heartstone_hall), a kelp line on the seabed (s_seabed), a candle shadow (s_forbidden_chamber), a star in the Priory dome (s_priory_halls). Read by s_glyph_seal, where each fills one part of row IV. Accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16 (phase 2); what the row says with all six is phase 3.

state.name: second_reader_seen
state.description: The Second Reader: in Star Chart II a line drew itself to the Scholar's Lamp's lost star, in Seraphyne's hand, and Kael saw it. Read at the Moot (Kael's lines) and in Star Chart III, where the Scholar's missing star is the one she placed. Accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16 (phase 2).

state.name: stars_black
state.description: Figures named to a lying strip and left gilded black (Star Chart II and III). Each lights a false band in s_flight_descent until it is unpicked. Accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16 (phase 2).

state.name: tarns_rib_tuned
state.description: After the Bone Choir's door opened, the one rib that is not ancient was tuned anyway, and the hall played a seventh note. One of the conditions of The Empty Saddle (phase 3). Accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16 (phase 2).

state.name: tarn_named
state.description: In s_empty_saddle the party learned whose rib it is: Tarn, Dorrin Vael's dragon, dead in the long sleep. Accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16 (phase 2).

state.name: ilvarra_recalled
state.description: On the bone bridge Ilvarra stopped, drawn in outline, and was Recalled as a ledge is. Accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16 (phase 2).

state.name: name_retold_to_voice
state.description: In s_last_witness the party Retold the prisoner's name to him, as it did for forgetful elders. Accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16 (phase 2); what it changes in the endings is phase 3.

state.name: final_choice
state.description: The answer at s_choice.

state.name: keeper_pair
state.description: The pair that keeps watch in The Rememberer; only pairs whose realm is 20+.

state.name: record
state.description: The party's Record: every entry kept, fading or forgotten.

state.name: burned
state.description: Entries burned in battle. Accepted 2026-11-15: a Burn made at a witness's own asking is a mercy, and takes that witness off the kill-list (see ysolde).

state.name: witnesses
state.description: People who remember, and their fate.

state.name: requests
state.description: The six requests and their state (open, forgotten, delivered).
